doc_title_en: Notice on Publication of Consolidated Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (including 80th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend) for FY3/27
doc_title_jp: 連結業績予想及び配当予想（設立80周年記念配当含む）の公表に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 80周年記念、普通配当¥10増、安定的配当方針に基づく

summary_en: FY3/27 dividend increased to ¥120/share (¥110 ordinary + ¥10 80th anniversary commemorative) vs ¥100 in FY3/26. Ordinary dividend raised ¥10. Mid-term dividend ¥65/share (¥55 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative); year-end dividend ¥55/share. Payout ratio target 40% basis; implied ratio ~47% on consolidated EPS ¥256.18. Company reached 80th anniversary January 2026.
summary_jp: FY3/27配当を¥120/株に引き上げ（通常¥110+記念¥10、前期¥100）。普通配当¥10増配。中間¥65/株（通常¥55+記念¥10）、期末¥55/株。配当性向目安40%、実績約47%。設立80周年記念配当を実施。
tag_en: Dividend policy - FY3/27: ¥120/sh (¥110 ordinary + ¥10 80th anniversary) vs ¥100 prior - payout ratio ~47% - raised ordinary by ¥10
